rawCliLogReferences.note: Raw CLI logs remain under packet/logs and were not copied into this snapshot.

sourceSelection.included: Every plain regular file under the builder lane after the exclusions below. This preserves project source, configuration, lockfiles, assets, tests, and app/lib/snapback/scripts/custom-client trees when present.
sourceSelection.traversal: recursive, lexical path order, symbolic links never followed or archived
sourceSelection.securityBoundary: .snapback4 trees and dotenv/environment files are excluded recursively; raw CLI logs are represented only by path, size and SHA-256.
